spec.title: fuguresearch — started plan (2026-07-11 01:10)
spec.p: **Plan:** `fractality/v0.1.0/spec/plans/FRACTALITY-FUGU-RESEARCH-PLAN-v0.1.xml` — Campaign 3 · Stage A2: the Sakana Fugu research. Launched at birth per the owner's «Напиши план и выполни» (no execution gate). Method inherited from the RLM research plan (waves, clean-room intake, tiered study, synthesis form); deviations: four owner-named anchors, no fixed 5/5/5, and a second analysis deliverable — the Fugu↔fractality mapping with Stage B draft amendments.

list.item: [ ] Ф1 — W1 deep research (background) + W2 12 frozen queries (before reading W1); raws → `refs/study/fugu-waves/`
[ ] Ф2 — merge: anchors + adopted extras + runners-up; INVENTORY rows with license verdicts BEFORE study
[ ] Ф3 — intake: site snapshot, PDFs, repos @pins, snapshots
[ ] Ф4 — study: T1 Fugu (page+tech report) → T2 TRINITY / L2O / extras → T3 grouped; GLM surveys under live observation (first-output timeout armed — Stage A lesson)
[ ] Ф6 — `FUGU-FRACTALITY-MAPPING.xml` (× RD-deltas / VISION / D-C3) + Stage B draft amendments
[ ] Ф7 — close: P-F1…P-F4 verdicts, ledger, completed dashboard
The topic is narrow and fresh (anchor arXiv id is June 2026) — candidate pool may be thin (P-F1's falsifier is a real branch).
sakana.ai may be JS-heavy for snapshots — fallback: WebFetch extraction recorded as the study copy, marked as such.
Delegate stall risk carried from Stage A: first-output timeout on every GLM launch this time, not only mid-run silence.
Mapping discipline: changes to the Stage B draft must cite FD-deltas — no vibes-only edits to a plan the owner will commission.
